summary: A short WordPress specimen for Schijn, a faceted 'gemstone' display family with layerable cut and rough styles: a run of full-width poster images in saturated coral, yellow, pink and cyan (feature list in mixed styles, 'gemstone' in many languages, symbols and alphabets, two annotated callout posters, a dingbat wall), separated by short navy text interludes, ending with a Try or Buy line. All specimens are flat PNG images; fixed bars and a cookie dialog overlay the capture.

instances.look: Two fixed bars (HTML only, repeated over the stitched crops): a white 'View all Typearture typefaces ▾' dropdown bar with a navy 'About | Contact | Legal | FAQ' strip, and a yellow bar with the T/a logo, 'Buy | Try | Specimen' at the left, 'Schijn: a multifaceted family' in pink in the centre and an Instagram icon at the right

On coral, five centred lines 'Four different styles / multilingual support / opentype alternates / SMALL CAPS/oldstyle / and ☞ dingbats' in cream and yellow, each word in a different faceted style (outlined cut, filled, rough, small caps), with dingbat glyphs inline; a cookie dialog covers the bottom-right corner
instances.ux: static image; Buy and Try sit in the fixed yellow bar above
instances.learn: Write the feature list as the hero sentence and set each word in a different style: the list proves itself as you read it

reconstruction.layout: Full-width image 1440×662px under the 88px of fixed bars; 5 centred lines, ~115px line pitch, text block ~1140px wide
reconstruction.typography: Schijn styles (Cut Deep, Cut Middle, Cut Shallow, Rough, with their Inner layers) at ~100px, cream #f5e1a0 / yellow #f4f06a on coral; small caps line; inline dingbats (pointing hand, gem)

instances.look: Three short navy interludes between the posters, each a bold white heading and one or two small paragraphs: 'A multifaceted gemstone font' (gemstone cutting and raw stones as inspiration), 'The perfect cut' (character set beyond A–Z, dingbats of toil and glamour), 'A cut between' (Rough dingbats for mining's danger, Cut for luxury: 'limo to dump-truck and champagne to water')
instances.learn: Use a dark, quiet text band between loud poster images: the rhythm gives each poster its own entrance

reconstruction.layout: Full-width navy bands 230–365px tall; one text column ~750px wide starting at x≈340, vertically centred
reconstruction.typography: Heading ~16px Degular Bold white; body ~16px Degular Regular white, leading ~1.5 (the specimen font itself is not used for live text)
reconstruction.content: Concept copy: gemstone cutting, toil vs glamour

instances.look: On lemon yellow, five lines of the word 'gemstone' translated: 'GEMSTONE – Đá quý, Dārgakmens, PÄRL, Drágakő, KŌHATU, KLENOT, Edelstein, Juweel, edelsteen', in coral and pink faceted styles with small caps and inline dingbats
instances.learn: Translate the font's theme word into many languages to get a word wall full of diacritics that still stays on concept

reconstruction.layout: Full-width image 1440×662px, five left-aligned lines from x≈110, ~115px line pitch, words separated by commas
reconstruction.typography: Schijn Cut and Rough styles ~100px, coral #f77168 and pink on yellow, mixed caps/small caps
reconstruction.content: 'Gemstone' in Vietnamese, Latvian, Swedish, Hungarian, Maori, Czech, German, Dutch…

instances.look: Two callout posters: on coral, 'Glitteringer / Facet&Facet' in yellow faceted caps on a faint construction grid, with leader lines to small labels ('Capital height below ascender', 'Alternate shapes for various characters', 'Small capitals blend seamlessly with lower and uppercase', 'Optimal angles for maximum light reflection', 'Windows in the gemstones without losing brilliance', 'Choice of capital and small capital ampersand'); on navy, 'Gloss / Facet' with a pointing-hand dingbat in multicolour layered styles (pink, cyan, yellow facets) and labels ('Weights add detail to dingbats', 'Different weight combinations create depth', 'Five facet styles allow endless chromatic possibilities'…)
instances.learn: Annotate a display face like an engineering drawing (grid, dotted baselines, leader lines) to make its decorative logic look rigorous
